name: Business Cycles and Global Economy
description:
Economy moves in cycles. Depending on the state of economy (in whether expansion or downturn), the firms should adjust their
business and investment strategies. This course will look into the state of art of business cycles under the increasingly integrated
global economic system, and discuss the usefulness and application of the cyclical analyses for the appropriate and flexible decision making. Global business cycles; short and long cycles; fluctuation; synchronization; identification, driver and nature of cyclical movements; endogenous and exogenous views; political economy; role of manufacturing; transmission mechanism; trend analysis; structural shift in the global system; China; India; forecasting and indicators; COVID-19.
